title: When the Same Prompt Gives Different Answers (and the Same Answer Isn't Always Right): A Taxonomy of Failure Mechanisms, Testing, and Mitigation Strategies for LLM-Assisted Evidence Synthesis Read-and-Evaluate Tasks
abstract: arXiv:2610.39070v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM read-and-evaluate tasks include study screening, data extraction, risk-of-bias assessment, and critical appraisal in the evidence synthesis field. These task differ in the amount of LLM interpretation they require. Some tasks involve retrieving relatively simple information, such as an author name, sample size, or publication year. Others require the LLM to read source material, interpret it against predefined criteria, and make a judgement. Researchers should assess whether LLM judgements are accurate, supported by appropriate source evidence, and reproducible under specified conditions. A correct judgement does not necessarily indicate that the underlying evaluation process is reliable. We developed a taxonomy for identifying mechanisms that may compromise these properties and for informing the selection and reporting of appropriate evaluation methods. translated_title: 当相同的提示给出不同的答案（而相同的答案也并非总是正确）：LLM辅助证据合成阅读-评估任务的失败机制、测试与缓解策略分类法
translated_abstract: LLM阅读-评估任务包括证据合成领域中的研究筛选、数据提取、偏倚风险评估和批判性评估。这些任务在所需LLM解释程度上存在差异：有些任务只需检索相对简单的信息，例如作者姓名、样本量或发表年份；另一些任务则要求LLM阅读源材料，依据预定义标准对其进行解读并作出判断。研究人员应当评估LLM的判断是否准确、是否有恰当的源证据支持，以及在指定条件下是否可复现。判断正确并不一定意味着其背后的评估过程是可靠的。我们开发了一个分类法，用于识别可能损害上述性质的机制，并为选择和报告适当的评估方法提供指导。该分类法概述了阅读-评估任务中LLM判断可能出现失效的潜在方式。
tldr: 该论文提出了一个分类法，用于识别LLM辅助证据合成阅读-评估任务中可能损害判断准确性、证据支持性与可复现性的失败机制，并据此指导测试方法与缓解策略的选择和报告。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a taxonomy for identifying failure mechanisms that may compromise the accuracy, evidential support, and reproducibility of LLM judgments in evidence synthesis read-and-evaluate tasks, guiding the selection and reporting of appropriate testing and mitigation strategies.
